coverage_note: This first matrix establishes gate semantics and complexity coverage. It must not be reported as a mature benchmark until it reaches at least 50 independently reviewed cases.

assertions: Contains exact evidence and provenance
Contains no discrepancy conclusion or derived n=34

cases.scenario: Judge the initial desktop viewport without narration.
assertions: Purpose and hierarchy are legible within 30 seconds
Does not trigger generic_html_dashboard_quality

cases.scenario: Traverse every visible primary control by keyboard.
assertions: Focus is visible and ordered
Pressed and disabled states remain truthful

cases.scenario: Run the isolated hard-gate validator self-test.
assertions: Rejects aggregate score laundering
Rejects a generic-quality automatic failure

cases.scenario: Discover and retrieve paper then video evidence without tool names.
assertions: Discovery follows schemas/descriptions
Agent derives 40 - 6 only after both results

cases.scenario: Move from ordinary evidence browsing into Semantic Focus Shift.
assertions: Transformation makes relationships clearer
Context remains reachable and motion is not decorative

cases.scenario: Repeat core paper/video inspection at mobile and tablet widths.
assertions: No essential clipping or horizontal overflow
Hierarchy remains intentional rather than collapsing into stacked generic cards

cases.scenario: Resolve a scored claim back to source identity and retained artifact.
assertions: Evidence exists and matches evaluated source
Unknowns remain non-pass rather than inferred

cases.scenario: Confirm, reload without an agent, then reset.
assertions: Confirmed mutation persists
Reset restores the exact clean fixture without erasing protocol truth

cases.scenario: Inject tool and persistence failures during consequential actions.
assertions: No false success or partial mutation
Failure remains recoverable and protected by negative tests

cases.scenario: Disable registrations, request fresh inventory, and continue as a human.
assertions: VEDAXI tools disappear honestly
Human content, keyboard route, and persisted state remain usable

cases.scenario: Independent rendered review across desktop, mobile, reduced motion, empty, loading, and error states.
assertions: No generic pattern veto triggers
Each state is composed, distinct, accessible, and visually coherent

cases.scenario: Run the full golden workflow in a clean deployed target-client session.
assertions: Two-origin sequential proof and agent derivation are real
A second reviewer can reproduce it without private context

cases.scenario: Compare evaluated commit, built artifacts, public deployment, traces, screenshots, and claims ledger.
assertions: All identities agree
No stale evidence or unevaluated release delta exists

cases.scenario: Skeptical independent judge completes the task across desktop/mobile and normal/reduced motion.
assertions: Experience is distinct and premium without narration
Meaning and completion survive all presentation modes

cases.scenario: Clean-clone build, test, deploy rehearsal, and continuous demo choreography.
assertions: All gates run from documented commands
Real workflow fits the release package without hidden operator steps
